cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Use the Right Vocabulary
cards.instruction: Perform belonging by using official language confidently, adjusting each term whenever someone reveals what it actually means.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. As your newest club member, I'd like to second the minutes. They took ages.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You second a motion. I'm proposing we approve the minutes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Then I second your motion. Unanimously.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Unanimous means everyone agrees. Ruth hasn't voted.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Seconded, with unanimity pending Ruth. Shall I put that in our minutes?
